meta.name: kernel-services
meta.description: Advanced Zephyr RTOS kernel services. Covers inter-thread communication using Zbus (pub/sub), behavioral management with the State Machine Framework (SMF), background processing via work queues, and persistent configuration with the Settings subsystem. Trigger when building modular application architectures, complex state-driven logic, or requiring persistent data storage.

copy.tagline: 在内嵌系统上构建核心服务，如线程通信、状态机和工作队列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要在 Zephyr RTOS 上开发模块化或状态驱动的应用
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop modular or state-driven applications on Zephyr RTOS

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude能够协助你使用Zephyr RTOS的Zbus（发布/订阅）、状态机框架（SMF）、工作队列和设置子系统，构建模块化、事件驱动的嵌入式应用。
howto.when: 当你需要开发模块化架构、复杂状态逻辑或持久化存储时，这个技能会自动激活并提供指导。

say.text: 帮我用Zbus实现两个模块之间的消息传递。
say.note: Claude会给出Zbus通道定义和发布/订阅的示例代码。

say.text: 设计一个状态机，管理设备的启动、运行和错误状态。
say.note: Claude会使用SMF框架创建状态表并给出过渡逻辑。

say.text: 如何将配置数据保存并重启后恢复？

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to help you use Zephyr RTOS kernel services: Zbus for publish/subscribe, SMF for state machines, work queues for background tasks, and Settings for persistent configuration, building modular embedded apps.
howto.when_en: Activate when you need to build modular architectures, complex state-driven logic, or persistent storage in Zephyr RTOS.

say_en.text: Show me how to use Zbus for communication between two modules.
say_en.note: Claude provides channel definition and pub/sub code.

say_en.text: Design a state machine for device lifecycle management.
say_en.note: Claude creates SMF state table and transitions.

say_en.text: How to save and restore configuration across reboots?
